description: What the Windows images are built from (host/build-images.ps1 passes these to the Dockerfiles as build arguments; every archive is checked against its SHA-256 inside the build). Versions follow the Linux deployment (infra/onprem/images.json): PostgreSQL 18.6, Keycloak 26.5.2, Node 24.22.2, nginx 1.30.6, ClamAV 1.4.6.

POSTGRES.source: EDB, the Windows binaries the PostgreSQL project links to (no checksum is published; pinned at first download, 2026-11-15)

PGVECTOR.source: pgvector source of the tag, compiled in the db image against the PostgreSQL binaries above

NODE.source: nodejs.org, equal to SHASUMS256.txt of the release

KEYCLOAK.source: Keycloak release; the SHA-1 of the same file equals the published keycloak-26.5.2.zip.sha1

JAVA.source: Eclipse Temurin 21 runtime, equal to the checksum of the Adoptium API

NGINX.source: nginx.org, nginx for Windows (pinned at first download, 2026-11-15)

CLAMAV.source: ClamAV release of Cisco Talos (pinned at first download, 2026-11-15)

WIN_ACME.source: win-acme release, used on the host by host/certificate.ps1 (not in an image)
